cases.name: structured_selection_busy
cases.rule: canonical storage busy hint inside MCP structured content

cases.name: structured_publication_busy
cases.rule: publication_busy is the other storage busy code

cases.name: bare_storage_hint
cases.rule: a bare native envelope points at the result itself

cases.name: undeclared
cases.rule: an inner busy hint alone is not an outer replay instruction

cases.name: declared_differs
cases.rule: declared metadata must equal the proposal exactly

cases.name: direct_admission_busy
cases.rule: unsubmitted busy admission keeps the brokerage

cases.name: direct_setup_busy
cases.rule: busy setup requires fresh brokerage

cases.name: direct_setup_without_fresh_brokerage
cases.rule: setup must declare fresh brokerage

cases.name: direct_submitted
cases.rule: a submitted query is never replayed

cases.name: delay_zero
cases.rule: delay must be 1..=1000 ms

cases.name: delay_maximum
cases.rule: 1000 ms is the inclusive bound

cases.name: delay_above_maximum
cases.rule: delay must be 1..=1000 ms

cases.name: truncated
cases.rule: a truncated composition is never replayed

cases.name: not_partial
cases.rule: only a partial composition can carry a member failure

cases.name: ranked
cases.rule: a non-empty ranking means results were delivered

cases.name: shared_values_present
cases.rule: shared values mean results were delivered

cases.name: member_succeeded
cases.rule: only a failed member can be retried

cases.name: member_cutoff
cases.rule: a cut-off member is not a busy refusal

cases.name: outer_error_retryable
cases.rule: the outer composition error itself must not be retryable

cases.name: publication_observed
cases.rule: a member with an observed publication is not unavailable

cases.name: text_disagrees_with_structured_content
cases.rule: text and structured content must agree

cases.name: storage_hint_submitted
cases.rule: query_submitted must be false when present

cases.name: storage_hint_unknown_field
cases.rule: hint fields are a closed set

cases.name: storage_hint_other_code
cases.rule: only publication_busy and selection_busy are storage busy codes

cases.name: request_id_128_bytes
cases.rule: request_id may be up to 128 bytes

cases.name: request_id_129_bytes
cases.rule: request_id may be up to 128 bytes

cases.name: two_projects
cases.rule: several distinct projects may share one index selection

cases.name: duplicate_projects
cases.rule: project ids must be unique

cases.name: two_indexes
cases.rule: only a single required member can be retried

cases.name: optional_members
cases.rule: member_availability must be require

cases.name: grant_revision_above_safe_integer
cases.rule: catalog revisions are 1..=i64::MAX; the value does not enter the retry record
cases.divergence: TypeScript parses JSON numbers as doubles and refuses non-safe integers; native accepts revisions up to i64::MAX. Conservative refusal (no replay).

cases.name: integral_float_delay
cases.rule: retry_after_ms must be a JSON integer

cases.name: selection_window_without_observation
cases.rule: one selection source needs no fabricated member observation

cases.name: selection_window_matching_observation
cases.rule: window observation must agree with its exact source

cases.name: selection_admin_matching_observation
cases.rule: admin observation uses the same exact-source rule

cases.name: selection_member_changed_owner
cases.rule: member selection owner, identity and revision must all match

cases.name: selection_member_changed_scope_identity
cases.rule: member selection owner, identity and revision must all match

cases.name: selection_member_changed_catalog_revision
cases.rule: member selection owner, identity and revision must all match

cases.name: selection_with_catalog_grant
cases.rule: catalog and selection sources are mutually exclusive

cases.name: selection_without_source
cases.rule: neither authority source is invalid

cases.name: selection_member_leaks_grant_nonce
cases.rule: public selection observations never carry native secrets

cases.name: selection_member_leaks_service_instance
cases.rule: public selection observations never carry native secrets

cases.name: selection_member_other_index
cases.rule: the member observation must name the sole selected index

cases.name: selection_member_other_project
cases.rule: membership observations stay inside selected projects

binding_cases.name: active_window
binding_cases.rule: the exact captured window source and original request permit one replay

binding_cases.name: active_admin
binding_cases.rule: the exact captured admin source follows the same rule

binding_cases.name: coherent_stale_scope_identity
binding_cases.rule: coherent outer and inner metadata cannot replace original caller authority

binding_cases.name: coherent_stale_catalog_revision
binding_cases.rule: coherent outer and inner metadata cannot replace original caller authority

binding_cases.name: coherent_stale_owner
binding_cases.rule: coherent outer and inner metadata cannot replace original caller authority

binding_cases.name: caller_epoch_disagrees
binding_cases.rule: the captured source revision agrees with the captured window revision

binding_cases.name: coherent_other_index
binding_cases.rule: the original captured index set bounds even a coherent result

binding_cases.name: coherent_other_project
binding_cases.rule: the original requested project set bounds the observed membership

binding_cases.name: pruned_projects
binding_cases.rule: native membership pruning may retain a nonempty subset of requested projects

binding_cases.name: explicit_narrowed_index
binding_cases.rule: an explicit original index subset remains exact

binding_cases.name: project_resolved_index_subset
binding_cases.rule: explicit projects may resolve only a subset of known permitted indexes

binding_cases.name: coherent_other_permitted_index
binding_cases.rule: a sibling permitted index is not the explicitly requested index

binding_cases.name: original_report_mode
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: original_default_mode
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: original_indexes_without_projects
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: original_duplicate_projects
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: original_unknown_index
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: original_unknown_project
binding_cases.rule: invalid, widened or non-required original selectors never authorize replay

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_active
binding_cases.rule: the exact original grant/revision and known index selection permit replay

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_grant_changed
binding_cases.rule: an older or foreign grant cannot replace the captured grant

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_grant_revision_changed
binding_cases.rule: grant revision remains exact

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_metadata_clock_forward
binding_cases.rule: catalog metadata clock changes do not invent a different grant revision

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_other_index
binding_cases.rule: a coherent other index cannot replace the captured selection

binding_cases.name: catalog_single_pruned_projects
binding_cases.rule: catalog callers retain safe membership pruning

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_active
binding_cases.rule: the exact original grant/revision and known index selection permit replay

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_grant_changed
binding_cases.rule: an older or foreign grant cannot replace the captured grant

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_grant_revision_changed
binding_cases.rule: grant revision remains exact

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_metadata_clock_forward
binding_cases.rule: catalog metadata clock changes do not invent a different grant revision

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_other_index
binding_cases.rule: a coherent other index cannot replace the captured selection

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_pruned_projects
binding_cases.rule: catalog callers retain safe membership pruning

binding_cases.name: catalog_combined_unknown_expansion
binding_cases.rule: absent captured index membership is not fabricated from a receipt

binding_cases.name: window_reply_to_catalog_caller
binding_cases.rule: authority source kinds never substitute for one another

binding_cases.name: catalog_reply_to_window_caller
binding_cases.rule: a catalog grant cannot substitute for an active window source
